```{r setup, include=FALSE, cache = FALSE}
require("knitr")
## setting working directory
opts_knit$set(root.dir = Sys.getenv("P20_DATA_DIR", unset = "."))
```

```{r}
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
library(data.table)
pd <- fread("./v5.txt")
#colnames(pd)
table(pd$subtype,pd$RACE)
```
```{r}
rawdata <- read.table("./258samples_v5.txt", header = TRUE, sep="\t")
row.names(rawdata) <- rawdata[,1]
rawdata <- rawdata[c(-2:-4,-6:-43),-1]
```


```{r}
subtype <- 'UNS'
subdata <- rawdata[c(-1),rawdata[1,] == subtype]
dim(subdata)
```

```{r}
library(edgeR)
ge_data <- DGEList(counts = data.matrix(subdata[c(-1),]))
racelevel <- subdata[1,]
racelevel[racelevel=='Black'] = "AA"
racelevel[racelevel=='White'] = "EA"
race <- as.factor(racelevel)
ge_data$samples$race <- race

seqdepth_mean <- mean(ge_data$samples$lib.size) * 1e-6
seqdepth_median <- median(ge_data$samples$lib.size) * 1e-6

summary(ge_data$samples$lib.size * 1e-6)

```
```{r}
nsamples <- ncol(ge_data)
table(rowSums(ge_data$counts==0)==nsamples)
```
```{r}
# Removing genes that are lowly expressed
keep.exprs <- filterByExpr(ge_data, group=race)
ge_data.unlowly <- ge_data[keep.exprs,, keep.lib.sizes=FALSE]
dim(ge_data.unlowly)
```
```{r}
# Normalising gene expression distributions
ge_data.unlowly <- calcNormFactors(ge_data.unlowly, method = "TMM")
lcpm <- cpm(ge_data.unlowly, log=TRUE)

# design <- model.matrix(~0+group+race)
design <- model.matrix(~0+race)
colnames(design) <- gsub("race", "", colnames(design))
contr.matrix <- makeContrasts(
  AA.vs.EA = AA-EA, 
  levels = colnames(design))
contr.matrix
```
```{r}
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
v <- voom(ge_data.unlowly, design, plot=TRUE)
vfit <- lmFit(v, design)
vfit <- contrasts.fit(vfit, contrasts=contr.matrix)
efit <- eBayes(vfit)
plotSA(efit, main="Final model: Mean-variance trend")
dt <- decideTests(efit)
summary(dt)
```
```{r}
de.treat <- which(dt[,1]!=0)
Ctrl.vs.Treat <- topTreat(efit, coef=1, n=Inf)
significant.gene <- row.names(Ctrl.vs.Treat[Ctrl.vs.Treat$adj.P.Val<0.05,])
up.gene <- row.names(Ctrl.vs.Treat[Ctrl.vs.Treat$adj.P.Val<0.05&Ctrl.vs.Treat$logFC>0,])
down.gene <- row.names(Ctrl.vs.Treat[Ctrl.vs.Treat$adj.P.Val<0.05&Ctrl.vs.Treat$logFC<0,])
up.gene
down.gene
```
